thread:
maya: FYI — inbound from client SecurityOps: they need evidence of KMS key rotation, export of audit logs for last 90 days, SBOM, and remediation ETA for three vulns. Deadline: EOD Friday their timezone (UTC-5).
anil: Which CVEs/paths specifically?
maya: They listed: CVE-2025-0143 (grpc-core RCE, reported as critical), CVE-2024-3321 (openssl minor), and CVE-2024-2109 (container base distro pkg). Also asked us to confirm whether our runtime images include any third-party libs flagged in the SBOM.
liam: I patched grpc-core in staging yesterday. Deployment job failed with a sigsegv on ~2% of runs — investigating. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1876
emma: Customer also wants KMS key rotation proof. Where do we pull rotation logs? they want HSM/KMS audit trail and rotation policy.
anil: We keep rotation records in Cloud Audit Logs. Example to export CloudKMS events for a key-ring:
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key_ring" AND protoPayload.methodName:"CryptoKeyVersion.rotate"' --project=redwood-prod --format=json > kms_rotate_events.json
```
I'll filter and produce a CSV with timestamps and request IDs for the customer.
security-bot: vuln-triage created TICKET-1123 assigned to @anil @liam (priority: P1) — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/TICKET-1123 :rotating_light:
liam: For the base image update (debian-11 -> debian-12), two deps break: python-http2 and metrics-agent. Need test matrix run. ETA for base image build + e2e run ~48h after we fix tests.
customer-success: Uploaded the client's SOC2 questionnaire and their email to /shared/clients/bluefin/soc2_q1.pdf. I asked for clarification on their 'retrospective window' (90d vs 365d).
anil: For SOC2 evidence we can provide: key rotation policy doc (https://internal.redwood/docs/kms/rotation-policy.md), KMS rotate events (CSV), SBOM generated with syft, and the PRs referencing CVEs. I'll assemble a signed package and request security manager sign-off.
maya: Can we commit to a remediation timeline? Proposed: grpc-core to prod in 24h if staging clears, openssl patch in 3 days, base image upgrade within 7 days. Flag blockers now.
liam: Ack. Blocker: SRE needs to accept canary config for continuous-batch canaries. @sre-ops please review.
sre-ops: Reviewing canary config now. If staging passes, we can promote in 24-36h. :thumbsup: 
anil: Also adding the exact SBOM extraction command here for reproducibility:
```
syft packages --scope image --output json redwood/runtime:prod-2025-03-01 > sbom.json
jq -r '.artifacts[] | [.name,.version,.licenses[]?.name] | @csv' sbom.json > sbom_packages.csv
```
maya: Thanks. I'll reply to the customer's SecurityOps with the proposed timeline and say we'll deliver the artifacts by Friday EOD their timezone. I'll include TICKET-1123 and the list of deliverables.
security-bot: NOTE — CVE-2025-0143 flagged as embargoed disclosure until vendor coordination completed. Do not publicize until PR is merged and customer notified.
